facts.fact: Techzim describes the Act as the law under which POTRAZ will inspect data controllers from 1 September 2026 and under which a licence deadline of 12 March 2025 has already passed; dated by publication.

Techzim reports POTRAZ's Regulatory Notice 2 of 2026, published in the press the Sunday before 28 July 2026, announcing mandatory risk-based compliance inspections of data controllers from 1 September 2026, starting with financial institutions, insurers, local authorities, health providers, mining firms, schools and others; no decision is reported.
Techzim states the Act made POTRAZ the Data Protection Authority, which issued a Regulatory Notice 2 of 2026 on compliance inspections; dated by the article's publication date, 2026-07-28.
